apple.name: Openline: Travel eSIM Plans
apple.subtitle: Data plans for travelers
apple.promotional: Pick a destination, choose a plan, and set up data before you travel. Unlimited usage or Fixed usage plans available.
apple.description:
When you arrive somewhere new, mobile data lets you pull up directions, message people, and use the apps that make travel easier. Openline gives you a way to get that data before you go.

An eSIM is a digital SIM built into your phone. Instead of sourcing a physical card, you browse plans in the app, choose one that fits your destination and trip length, and set it up through your device settings.

What you can do in the app:
- Choose between "Unlimited usage" or "Fixed usage" plans, where available for your destination
- Fixed usage plans provide a set data allowance; unlimited usage plans may be subject to fair-use terms
- Check remaining data on active plans, where applicable

Getting started:
1. Find your destination and review available plans
2. Choose a plan type and duration
3. Follow installation instructions and review your chosen plan's usage guidance

Requires a compatible unlocked eSIM-capable iPhone. Plan types, availability, and validity vary by destination. Review applicable usage terms before purchasing.
